title: dhive
tagline: Dhive is an all-in-one hub where governance meets vibrant community dialogues. Monitor proposals, engage in a decentralized forum, and get personalized notifications.
description: Dhive seamlessly combines governance insights with vibrant discussions in the Web3 realm. Beyond a platform, Dhive is your compass, directing you towards meaningful dialogue, and active participation in shaping the decentralized space. Engage with confidence, stay informed, and ensure credibility in all your Web3 interactions.
how_its_made:
## **Links:**

- **Website:** [Dhive.io](https://dhive.io)
- **Discord:** [Join Us](https://discord.gg/Pn2rhjJ6vE)
---
 
 
## **Repositories & Tools:**

- **Frontend Repo:** [dhive-frontend](https://github.com/SamixDev/dhive-frontend)
- **Backend Repo:** [dhive-backend](https://github.com/SamixDev/dhive-backend)
- **Contract Repo:** [dhive-contracts](https://github.com/SamixDev/dhive-contracts)
- **Contract Explorer:** [View on Sepolia Scrollscan](https://sepolia.scrollscan.dev/address/0xab17f8d78f6b26c898208f45caba9dc05f9cfd39#code)
---
 
 
## **Core Features:**

- **🌐 Real-time Governance Proposals:**

  - Get a front-row seat to the latest governance proposals from a myriad of Web3 communities, ensuring every voice is heard.

- **📢 Scroll-Powered Discussion Forums:**

  - Engage in decentralized conversations that mirror platforms like Reddit. Share, debate, and co-create the Web3 narrative.

- **🔔 Instant Notifications:**

  - Dhive ensures you're always in the know. Receive timely notifications for new proposals, posts, and discussions tailored to your interests.

- **🛡 Trusted Interactions:**

  - With Mask Network's Next.Id, boost your profile's trust quotient. Flaunt your Web3 identities and interact with added credibility.

- **🎯 Tailored Community Recommendations:**
  - Dhive's intelligent algorithms recommend communities to follow based on your token holdings, ensuring you're aligned with governance decisions and discussions that matter to you.
---
 
 
## **Challenges Addressed by Dhive:**

- **🧩 Simplifying Web3 Governance:**

  - Dhive structures and clarifies the vast world of Web3 governance, making participation intuitive and impactful.

- **📣 Elevating Discussions:**

  - With the Scroll Network, Dhive nurtures rich, decentralized discussions, fostering collective intelligence and community growth.

- **🚨 Always Being Informed:**

  - With Dhive's bespoke notification system, never miss out on a post, proposal, or discussion pivotal to your Web3 journey.

- **🌟 Trust & Credibility in Web3:**
  - Dhive bridges anonymity and authenticity, ensuring each interaction is rooted in trust.
---
 
 
## **Technical Stack:**

- **Frontend:** Next.js
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js
- **Database:** PostgreSQL
- **Smart Contracts:** Solidity
---
 
 
## **Protocols & Technologies Integrated:**

- **Scroll Network:**

  - The heart of our decentralized discussion forums, ensuring transparency and community-driven content.

- **Push Protocol:**

  - Driving our real-time notifications, keeping you connected with the pulse of Web3.

- **Filecoin & Web3.Storage:**

  - Protecting user-generated content through decentralized storage, emphasizing data integrity.

- **Mask Network's Next.Id:**

  - A layer of trust for the Web3 community. Engage with verifiable identities, building authentic connections.

- **ApeCoin**
  - A nod to one of Web3's influential projects, Dhive offers a special corner for ApeCoin enthusiasts, including unique badges for Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) NFT holders.
---
 
 
## **Supported Web3 Communities:**

Dhive thrives on community strength. Celebrating the myriad governance perspectives of Web3 entities, including:

- Push Protocol
- ApeCoin DAO
- MASK
- UMA Protocol
- Mantle
- Uniswap
- Connext
- SafeDAO

Join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/Pn2rhjJ6vE) and have a direct say in which community we integrate next! Let's shape Dhive's future together. 🚀
